title: PatchSet
description: An ordered list of targeted edits across one or more existing resources (panel/dashboard/dataSource/pipeline/pipelineStep/output), produced by conversational refinement so a diff can be previewed and applied atomically. HEL-907 task 1.2: patch-set operations target nodes (the existing `pipelineStep` kind — a PipelineStep IS a node), Outputs (the `output` kind, ADDED by that task), and placements (the existing `panel` kind — an OutputPanel IS a placement) — HEL-904 removed the `dataType`/`metric` target kinds outright (DataType/Metric no longer exist). HEL-914 task 5.1: `EditTarget` gains `parentId`, closing the gap that used to block `create` for any child resource -- `pipelineStep` create (a lane, naming its parent pipeline via `target.parentId`) is the first consumer. `output` still has no `create` op: the parent-id gap that used to explain this is now closed, but nothing exercises an `output` create yet (a deliberate, documented absence, not a remaining impossibility). A future apply path (HEL-406 and siblings) consumes this artifact.

summary.description: Optional human-readable description of the whole patch set (e.g. an agent's one-line summary of the refinement).

edits.description: Ordered list of targeted edits, applied in array order by a future apply path.

Edit.description: One targeted edit against a single resource. `patch`'s real shape reuses the existing per-resource PATCH/create request shapes rather than inventing new ones, documented here by name (none of the seven has its own standalone schema file to $ref against): for op=update, the existing UpdatePanelRequest/UpdateDashboardRequest/UpdateDataSourceRequest/UpdatePipelineRequest/UpdatePipelineStepRequest/UpdateOutputRequest shape matching target.kind (the same type the matching PATCH endpoint already decodes); for op=create, the matching CreatePanelRequest/CreateDashboardRequest/CreateDataSourceRequest/CreatePipelineRequest/CreatePipelineStepRequest shape (`output` alone has no create op — see EditTarget's own description), decoded by a future apply path (HEL-406), not this contract; for op=delete, `patch` is unused.

patch.description: Partial update body, real shape selected by (target.kind, op) — see this schema's own description above. Absent for delete edits.

EditTarget.description: Identifies the resource an Edit applies to. `id` is required for update/delete (enforced by Edit's own if/then) and optional for create, where the resource does not yet exist. HEL-914 task 5.1: `parentId` names the parent resource a not-yet-existing CHILD resource is created under -- required (and, per Edit's own if/then, non-blank) for a `create` targeting a child kind (currently only `pipelineStep`, whose `parentId` is the existing parent pipeline's id -- the step-level tree shape, i.e. which EXISTING step this lane branches off, is carried in `patch.parentStepId` instead), and REJECTED (not merely ignored) on update/delete, where it is meaningless. `output` (HEL-907 task 1.2) still has no valid `create` op: the parent-id gap this field closes for `pipelineStep` is not yet exercised for `output` (a deliberate, documented absence).
